input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: Renewal terms sit at the playbook preferred position. Section 8.2 provides automatic renewal in successive twelve-month periods (no multi-year renewal), a Customer opt-out on only thirty days' written notice (well inside the 30-day preferred window), and a Vendor reminder at least sixty days before renewal, with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed. Section 8.3 caps renewal increases to recurring Fees at the lesser of CPI over the preceding twelve months and three percent, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. No other provision creates a longer notice window, a multi-year renewal, or an uncapped uplift, so no redline is needed.
